title: Sloth in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='15' width='90' height='8' rx='4' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='5' y='15' width='90' height='3' rx='2' fill='#A0714F'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#9E7B5A'/>
  <!-- Belly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#C4A67C'/>
  <!-- Left arm up to branch -->
  <path d='M32 48 Q22 30 30 18' stroke='#9E7B5A' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm up to branch -->
  <path d='M68 48 Q78 30 70 18' stroke='#9E7B5A' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Claws on left arm -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='18' r='3' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
  <!-- Claws on right arm -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='18' r='3' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#9E7B5A'/>
  <!-- Face lighter mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#D4B88C'/>
  <!-- Eye patches (dark) -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='31' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5A4030'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='31' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5A4030'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='31' r='2' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='31' r='2' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='30' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#5A4030'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M46 40 Q50 44 54 40' stroke='#5A4030' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='24' r='3' fill='#9E7B5A'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='24' r='3' fill='#9E7B5A'/>
  <!-- Scarf around neck -->
  <path d='M35 46 Q50 52 65 46' stroke='#E84040' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Scarf tail hanging -->
  <path d='M60 46 Q64 52 62 60 Q60 64 56 62' stroke='#E84040' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Scarf detail lighter -->
  <path d='M37 46 Q50 51 63 46' stroke='#FF6B6B' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Scarf tail stripes -->
  <path d='M60 50 Q63 54 62 57' stroke='#FF6B6B' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M59 54 Q62 57 61 60' stroke='#FF6B6B' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Legs hanging down -->
  <path d='M42 72 Q40 82 38 85' stroke='#9E7B5A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 72 Q60 82 62 85' stroke='#9E7B5A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Claws on feet -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='86' r='2.5' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='86' r='2.5' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
</svg>
